notes: 9.14: Update now finishes by itself - the installer waits for the app to close, installs without a click and reopens the app; a downloaded installer is reused, not fetched twice; the next sign-in says Updated to 9.14 or offers the download again; the version shows in the title bar; the Omni Flash address works without https://; one installer at a time. Includes 9.10-9.13.
